question: What is the great nest with sixteen called by name?
premises: The great nest is associated with twice-eight.
This is called bhadra-kūṭaka by name.
inference: The sixteen-part great nest is named bhadra-kūṭaka.
uncertainties: Whether dviraṣṭa modifies count or measure is implicit.
plain_english: This great nest of sixteen is called bhadra-kūṭaka.
